sprint: Studio: Place Resize + Shape Controls, Gated on Story-Author Permission
task: The user's own single governing request, now fully closed: 'also studio is not providing options to personalize frames. allow studio to put image as frame. and also change the size and shape of place if story author has allowed it.' This ships the second half (the first, image-as-Frame, shipped separately as build 0284). `resizable` is a genuinely new Place permission, deliberately defaulting to closed when absent (mirroring `moveable`'s own convention, opposite `editable`'s) on both the read side (renderer/slideRenderer.js's _resolvePlacePermissions) and the compile side (tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/builder.js's convergeScene) -- no already-authored Place silently gains resize/shape capability. _supportsResize now checks a Place's own `resizable` flag before the generic locked gate, so a resizable Place shows real 8-corner resize handles; a new _applyPlaceSizeOverride resizes about the authored rect's own pre-move centre, layered under the existing move-override at every Place-rect call site. A new _resolvePlaceShape (exported as SlideRenderer.getPlaceShape) resolves a Story-Author shape override, else the Theme-Author-authored value, else 'rectangle'; _drawImage gained an optional trailing placeId and a real shape-clip branch (circle/rounded/rectangle), a no-op for every caller with no Place concept. js/selectionActionStrip.js's Edit popup now mounts a real 3-choice Shape picker for a resizable Place, writing through the existing generic SceneEngine.setContentOverride mutator; a non-resizable Place shows zero handles and zero picker, falling through to the unchanged plain fallback -- Guardrails honoured with no separate check bypassable. World Builder v2's Place permission block gained a fourth 'Can a Story Author change its size or shape?' checkbox. A real pixel-sampling contamination bug was found and fixed in the test itself (the selected object's own gold resize handle covers the sample point regardless of underlying shape) -- fixed by deselecting before every sample, matching this codebase's own established precedent for this exact class of bug. Verified via a new 26-assertion Playwright suite (a real mouse-driven resize drag genuinely repaints the canvas; a real Shape pick genuinely clips the artwork, confirmed via deselected pixel sampling; Guardrails confirmed via a synthetic theme with `resizable` deliberately absent). Full regression: place_guardrails_runtime_verify.js, museum_realfile_pixelhash.js (byte-identical SHA256 to prior history), and frame_image_verify.js (the sibling Frame-image feature, confirming shared render call sites compose with zero interference) all pass unchanged; both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged, confirming zero impact beyond the one additive `resizable` compile field. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; confined to renderer/slideRenderer.js, js/selectionActionStrip.js, js/app.js, tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/builder.js, and tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js. This closes the user's entire original two-part governing request.
